# Frontend Vendor Files

These files are vendored to make the production frontend independent from
external CDN availability.

- `react.production.min.js`
  - Package: React UMD production build
  - Version: 18.3.1
  - Source URL: https://unpkg.com/react@18.3.1/umd/react.production.min.js
  - License: MIT

- `react-dom.production.min.js`
  - Package: ReactDOM UMD production build
  - Version: 18.3.1
  - Source URL: https://unpkg.com/react-dom@18.3.1/umd/react-dom.production.min.js
  - License: MIT

- `babel.min.js`
  - Package: Babel Standalone
  - Version: 7.29.0
  - Source URL: https://unpkg.com/@babel/standalone@7.29.0/babel.min.js
  - License: MIT
